title: Enigma Jappeere Woɗɗunde
intro: Laamɗo doole, barkinaaɗo e laamu keewngu, ina joginoo caɗeele keewɗe, tawi ina jeyaa heen laamɗo debbo ummoriiɗo leydi woɗɗundi. Laamɗo oo yiɗi ko hollirde doole e hakkille Alla, o waɗti waɗde heen huunde nde alaa ɗo haaɗi, nde luulndii sariyaaji sahaa e nokku. Mbele aɗa waawi ƴettude heen geɗe kaawniiɗe?
clues: Laamɗo ina rokka doole keewɗe, ina jeyaa heen jogaade doole e dow tagooje ɗe njiyataa e waawde yamirde henndu.
Oo laamɗo heɓi kabaaru laamɗo debbo alɗuɗo rewoowo naange, felliti noddude ɗum to suudu sarɗiiji.
Ko adii nde laamɗo debbo oo arata, laamɗo oo hollitii yiɗde mum addude jooɗorde laamu mawnde ummoraade e laamu mum woɗɗungu.
Jinnaaɗo mawɗo ina sakkitoo ƴettude huunde ndee hade laamɗo oo umminde e diiso mum.
Kono, gooto jogiiɗo ganndal luggiɗngal e Binndi Alla ɗii, ina rokka heen ƴeewndo ɓurngo yaawde, ina timmina golle ɗee e nder ɓuuɓri gite.
Nde nde ari, laamɗo oo yamiri yo huunde ndee wayle ngam ƴeewde hakkille laamɗo debbo oo e faayiida mum nde o arti e galle laamorɗo oo.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
